extract_edges.py:147 _frontmatter_declarations already parses frontmatter (yaml.safe_load at :162), but the path scanner _explicit_source_file_declarations (:338, locator at :348) only line-scans and skips provenance fields; reading the key must be wired in.
'no per-file allowlist' forbids a code-level filename list; adding the marker to the two files is data annotation applied by one general rule, so it is not contradictory.

The two files are not SLDB-tracked: .sldb/core/store_index.yaml lists no Issue model and .sldb/core/documents/ has no IssueDoc directory, so no model registration applies and stores check does not read them.
Compatible: the marker is evaluated on every extracted document (drawer/issues become kind 'issue', extract_docs.py:74), and only marked records are then skipped. No conflict.
